item.description: The updated proposal is being presented to the Board of Education, though no vote will be taken on Thursday night.

item.title: NE Philadelphia residents demand traffic safety changes after car crashes into home
item.description: Community members say cars, trucks and even tractor-trailers routinely come off Route 63 and fail to slow down as they enter the residential area.

item.title: Instagram says it will notify parents if teens 'repeatedly' search for terms related to suicide

item.title: Pine Forge Academy's legacy of Black education endures after 80 years
item.description: As part of Black History Month, Action News' Leland Pinder visited the historic Adventist boarding school near Pottstown to examine its origins, history and lasting impact on generations of students.

item.title: Franklin Mall to reopen in Northeast Philadelphia after fire prompts temporary closure
item.description: The mall - formerly known as Franklin Mills - was shut down by the Fire Department and the Department of Licenses and Inspections following a small fire on Saturday.
